title: Rav Chinena son of Rava of Pashrunya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Pesachim 76a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.76a.13-14) and [Chullin 112a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.112a.5) he permits a young pigeon that had fallen into a jar of kamka, and Rava said of him: “Who is wise enough to permit a matter like this, if not Rav Chinena son of Rava of Pashrunya, who is a great man?” In [Pesachim 91a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.91a.15) Hyman also cites a challenge by Rav Ukva bar Chinena of Parishna (or Pashrunya, Dikdukei Soferim).[^1]

notes.text: The two accounts describe the young bird falling into the jar. The consulted Pesachim 91a names Rava as the person challenged. Hyman’s compressed wording leaves the addressee implicit, and the alternative place-name is his report from Dikdukei Soferim.
